title: Forcing and cardinal invariants of universally null sets
summary: We study universally null sets in forcing extensions and the cardinal invariants of their ideal $\mathcal{UN}$. We prove that the Miller model contains a nonmeager universally null set of cardinality $\aleph_2=\mathfrak{c}$, answering a question of Brendle and Larson. The proof uses preservation of universal nullity by countable support iterations of Miller forcing and shows that the set of Miller reals added during the iteration is universally null.
